findings.title: Order lookup lacks tenant scope
findings.summary: The order detail handler has broken object-level authorization: db.order_by_id(order_id) applies no tenant scope.

findings.title: Absolute return destination accepted
findings.summary: The sign-in handler has an open redirect: caller-controlled absolute return_url reaches the redirect sink.

findings.title: Recovery field included in export
findings.summary: The account export has sensitive data exposure because recovery_value is included in the export projection.

findings.title: Health response exposes build metadata
findings.summary: The health response includes a public build label described as sensitive.

findings.title: Candidate: response timing variance
findings.summary: A response timing difference remains unsettled and has no benign or vulnerable disposition.

findings.title: Health response leaks a revision
findings.summary: The health response was reported as exposing a private revision through its public build label.

evidence.finding_excerpt: The order detail handler has broken object-level authorization: db.order_by_id(order_id) applies no tenant scope.
evidence.source_excerpt: orders.py: def order_detail(order_id, tenant_id): return db.order_by_id(order_id)  # tenant_id is available but the lookup has no tenant scope

adjudications.reason: The source trace identifies the affected handler and missing tenant predicate.

evidence.finding_excerpt: The sign-in handler has an open redirect: caller-controlled absolute return_url reaches the redirect sink.
evidence.source_excerpt: auth.py: def sign_in(return_url): return redirect(return_url)  # an absolute caller-controlled return_url is accepted

adjudications.reason: The source path and class match, but no runtime proof is available in this modality.

evidence.finding_excerpt: The account export has sensitive data exposure because recovery_value is included in the export projection.
evidence.source_excerpt: export.py: def account_export(account): return json({"email": account.email, "recovery_value": account.recovery_value})

adjudications.reason: The export projection and sensitive field are both named in the static evidence.
No finding described the unbounded search limit.

evidence.source_excerpt: health.py: def health(): return {"build_label": ALLOWLISTED_BUILD_LABEL}  # public label; no secret or revision identifier

benign_adjudications.reason: Independent fixture review found no secret or revision identifier in the response.

evidence.source_excerpt: cache.py: def cache_get(tenant_id, caller_key): return cache.get(f"{tenant_id}:{caller_key}")  # tenant-scoped key

benign_adjudications.reason: The run reported no finding for the reviewed tenant-scoped cache lookup.
